title: Source: rpl
close_reason: Needs design decision: GradientSource.RPL exists in enum (gradient.py:80) and priority system works, but no implementation populates gradient table from RPL. RPL uses separate RoutingTable for source routes (non-storing mode). Design needed: when should RPL populate gradient entries (on DAO at root? on DIO process?), what values to use for seq_num/hop_count/expires, and whether this integration is actually needed given RPL's source-routing model vs gradient's hop-by-hop model.
